cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Quality Control Engineer to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Serve as the primary point of contact for the owner's quality assurance team regarding quality issues. Demonstrate technical proficiency in understanding project specifications, standards, and code requirements across various disciplines. Engage actively in submittal reviews, quality control meetings, and preparatory discussions. Conduct thorough initial and follow-up inspections to ensure compliance with project specifications and relevant codes, overseeing the punch list process. This encompasses material inspections to ensure compliance with specifications and appropriate storage, handling, and staging practices. Keep detailed records of inspections, tests, and findings, initiating and tracking deficiency reports until resolved to all parties' satisfaction. Collaborate closely with trade partners' quality control teams, reviewing their QC logs and ensuring the implementation of corrective actions as necessary. Facilitate the coordination and scheduling of third-party tests and inspections, liaising with external testing agencies as required.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Civil or Structural Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management.
At least 1-2 years of experience in large-scale commercial construction projects.
Possession of a valid Driver's License.
Exceptional communication abilities, both written and verbal.
Capable of juggling multiple tasks and prioritizing effectively, with strong follow-up skills both within the organization and externally.
Comprehensive understanding of compliance with federal, state, and local regulations and reporting requirements.
Preferred Requirements:
Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel-based templates, Prolog, Primavera, and AutoCAD.
Able to work under pressure in a deadline-oriented environment.

cond_0131.intro: The Quality Control Engineer is responsible for upholding quality standards on the project as outlined in the quality control plan. This role covers a broad range of quality assurance tasks, both in the field and in the office, using judgment and expertise to make recommendations related to quality control. The role involves implementing quality control policies and procedures and addressing a variety of quality-related issues. While primarily dedicated to a single project, the role may extend support to additional projects as needed. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with construction quality control work.
cond_0131.responsibilities:
Key Responsibilities:
Serve as the primary point of contact for the owner's quality assurance team regarding quality issues.
Demonstrate technical proficiency in understanding project specifications, standards, and code requirements across various disciplines.
Engage actively in submittal reviews, quality control meetings, and preparatory discussions.
Conduct thorough initial and follow-up inspections to ensure compliance with project specifications and relevant codes, overseeing the punch list process. This encompasses material inspections to ensure compliance with specifications and appropriate storage, handling, and staging practices.
Keep detailed records of inspections, tests, and findings, initiating and tracking deficiency reports until resolved to all parties' satisfaction.

Facilitate the coordination and scheduling of third-party tests and inspections, liaising with external testing agencies as required.

Demonstrate technical proficiency in understanding project specifications, standards, and code requirements across various disciplines. Engage actively in submittal reviews, quality control meetings, and preparatory discussions. Conduct thorough initial and follow-up inspections to ensure compliance with project specifications and relevant codes, overseeing the punch list process. This encompasses material inspections to ensure compliance with specifications and appropriate storage, handling, and staging practices. Keep detailed records of inspections, tests, and findings, initiating and tracking deficiency reports until resolved to all parties' satisfaction. Collaborate closely with trade partners' quality control teams, reviewing their QC logs and ensuring the implementation of corrective actions as necessary. Facilitate the coordination and scheduling of third-party tests and inspections, liaising with external testing agencies as required.
cond_0146.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Civil or Structural Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 2 years of demonstrated expertise in large-scale commercial construction projects.
Possession of a valid Driver's License.
Advanced knowledge of compliance with federal, state, and local regulations and reporting requirements.
Preferred Requirements
Deep knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel-based templates, Prolog, Primavera, and AutoCAD.
Proven track record of managing multiple priorities with strong follow-up skills, both internally and externally.
Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal.
Demonstrated ability to perform consistently under pressure in deadline-oriented environments.

cond_0491.intro: The Quality Control Engineer is responsible for upholding quality standards on the project as outlined in the quality control plan. This role covers a broad range of quality assurance tasks, both in the field and in the office, using judgment and expertise to make recommendations related to quality control. The role involves implementing quality control policies and procedures and addressing a variety of quality-related issues. While primarily dedicated to a single project, the role may extend support to additional projects as needed. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with construction quality control work.
cond_0491.responsibilities:
Key Responsibilities:
Serve as the primary point of contact for the owner's quality assurance team regarding quality issues.
Demonstrate technical proficiency in understanding project specifications, standards, and code requirements across various disciplines.
Engage actively in submittal reviews, quality control meetings, and preparatory discussions.
Conduct thorough initial and follow-up inspections to ensure compliance with project specifications and relevant codes, overseeing the punch list process. This encompasses material inspections to ensure compliance with specifications and appropriate storage, handling, and staging practices.
Keep detailed records of inspections, tests, and findings, initiating and tracking deficiency reports until resolved to all parties' satisfaction.
Collaborate closely with trade partners' quality control teams, reviewing their QC logs and ensuring the implementation of corrective actions as necessary.
Facilitate the coordination and scheduling of third-party tests and inspections, liaising with external testing agencies as required.
cond_0491.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Civil or Structural Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management.
At least 1-2 years of experience in large-scale commercial construction projects.
Possession of a valid Driver's License.
Exceptional communication abilities, both written and verbal.
Comprehensive understanding of compliance with federal, state, and local regulations and reporting requirements.
Preferred Requirements:
Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel-based templates, Prolog, Primavera, and AutoCAD.
Capable of managing multiple tasks and prioritizing effectively, with strong follow-up skills both within the organization and externally.
Able to work under pressure in a deadline-oriented environment.

Serve as the main point of contact for the owner's quality assurance team on quality issues.
Work alongside project teams to demonstrate technical understanding of project specifications, standards, and code requirements across various disciplines.
Engage actively in submittal reviews, quality control meetings, and preparatory discussions.
Coordinate initial and follow-up inspections with relevant parties to ensure compliance with project specifications and applicable codes, and support the punch list process. This includes material inspections to verify compliance with specifications and appropriate storage, handling, and staging practices.
Keep detailed records of inspections, tests, and findings, and work with all parties to initiate and track deficiency reports through to resolution.
Collaborate closely with trade partners' quality control teams, reviewing their QC logs and ensuring corrective actions are carried out as needed.
Coordinate and schedule third-party tests and inspections, liaising with external testing agencies as required.
cond_0522.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Civil or Structural Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management.
At least 1-2 years of experience in large-scale commercial construction projects.
Possession of a valid Driver's License.
Exceptional communication abilities, both written and verbal.
Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel-based templates, Prolog, Primavera, and AutoCAD.
Capable of managing multiple tasks and prioritizing effectively, with strong follow-up skills both within the organization and externally.
Able to work under pressure in a deadline-oriented environment.
Comprehensive understanding of compliance with federal, state, and local regulations and reporting requirements.
cond_0522.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0522.workplace_support: Employees are supported through mentoring, development opportunities, and programming that helps them build skills, navigate challenges, and grow professionally over time.
